name: my-project-theme
source: Replace with a short description of where these tokens come from (e.g. 'design-system package v1.2.0', 'Figma library X', 'tailwind.config.js').

palette.__comment: Add your hex -> token mappings here, e.g. '#FFFFFF': 'white'. Use uppercase hex. These are exact matches — the extractor flags colors in this map with a ✅ badge.

semanticOverrides.__comment: Add hex -> { token, role } for colors that should map by semantic role even when the RGB distance isn't the closest. Example: '#8FC3C3': { 'token': 'brand30', 'role': 'accent-brand' }. These are flagged with a 🎨 badge and take priority over palette matches.

colors.__comment: Phase 5 `tokenize` reads this block. `tokenMap` is hex -> Dart getter name (e.g. '#0BA284' -> 'brand30'). Tokens are resolved via `<accessor>.<name>`, e.g. `context.customColors.brand30`.

spacing.__comment: Phase 5 `tokenize` reads this block. `scale` maps px -> suffix index. Example: `"16": 4` turns a scaffold `EdgeInsets.all(16)` into `EdgeInsets.all(YHAppSpacing.sp4)`.

radius.__comment: Phase 5 `tokenize` reads this block. Same shape as spacing.scale; use string suffixes like 'full' for pill shapes (e.g. `"9999": "full"` -> `YHAppCornerRadiusV2.rfull`).

typography.__comment: Phase 5 `tokenize` converts `TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Inter', fontSize, fontWeight, color, height, letterSpacing)` into `<helper>(size:, weight:, color:, height:, letterSpacing:)`. Only Inter TextStyles are rewritten (matches helper default).
typography.signature: interText({required double size, required int weight, Color? color, double? height, double? letterSpacing})
